task.description: Implement ADP-06 per src/design/adp-06-pipeline-run-correlation.md. Add additive schema support for nullable audit.pipeline_run_id UUID and implement propagation of pipeline_run_id into event metadata for pipeline-driven actions while preserving null/absent behavior for non-pipeline actions. Update write/read paths needed to make pipeline-produced audit and event records queryable by pipeline_run_id, including any additive indexes required by the design. Add or update tests that verify write-path propagation, queryability, and backward-compatible null behavior. Run full backend validation required by BACKEND-DEV workflow before completing handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Schema migration adds nullable pipeline_run_id UUID to audit with backward compatibility
Pipeline-driven actions persist pipeline_run_id consistently in audit and event metadata surfaces
Query paths support filtering or correlation by pipeline_run_id for pipeline-generated records
Tests demonstrate pipeline correlation behavior and non-pipeline null compatibility
zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate exit 0

result.summary: Implemented ADP-06 pipeline run correlation: additive audit_entries.pipeline_run_id migration and index support, trusted pipeline_run_id claim propagation to DB session context, event metadata propagation on write, and audit/event read-path filtering/query support with integration coverage.
